audit_items.proof_trace: Monotonicity is enforced by two independent mechanisms: (1) `set_value` (borrow_index.move:25) contains an explicit runtime assertion `assert!(self.value.le(value))` that aborts the transaction if the new index would decrease; (2) `Decimal` is backed by `u256` (unsigned), so `interest_rate` is always ≥ 0, making `new_index = (1 + simpleInterestFactor) * prior ≥ prior` mathematically guaranteed. `create_interest_model` (asset.move:178-179) also validates parameter ordering, ensuring all `float::sub` range computations in `calc_interest` are non-negative.
